mapper.select: SELECT * FROM t_question_star_data WHERE sojumpparm like concat('%', #{elementId}, '%') and is_deleted = 0
select distinct questionnaire_id, element_id, process_id from t_questionnaire_data where groups_id = #{groupId}

select a.*,b.username from (select groups_id, question_name, question_sort, element_id, round, answer, user_id, process_id, questionnaire_id from t_questionnaire_record where is_deleted = 0 and groups_id = #{groupId} and questionnaire_id = #{questionnaireId} and element_id = #{elementId} and process_id = #{processId} and source_type = 'WORKPROCESS'
union all
select groups_id, question_name, question_sort, element_id, round, scale_grade, user_id, process_id, questionnaire_id from t_questionnaire_scale where is_deleted = 0 and groups_id = #{groupId} and questionnaire_id = #{questionnaireId} and element_id = #{elementId} and process_id = #{processId} and source_type = 'WORKPROCESS'
union all
select groups_id, question_name, question_sort, element_id, round, choice_context, user_id, process_id, questionnaire_id from t_questionnaire_selection where is_deleted = 0 and groups_id = #{groupId} and questionnaire_id = #{questionnaireId} and element_id = #{elementId} and process_id = #{processId} and source_type = 'WORKPROCESS') a left join sys_user b on a.user_id = b.id order by a.user_id, a.question_name, a.question_sort
